en: Like a rose, a rose, come, take my hand.
Like wine, O people, O people, they are intoxicated by you.
Your arm has become God's bow.
Your arrow shot out of the sky.
Your zeal said, "Go away, there is no way."
Your mercy said, "Come, there is a way."
Your grace is like an ocean, and I am its fish.
Your zeal purified me, cleansed me.

Your balm seeks out the wounded.
I have no worries about your cleansing, I am weary, weary.
O You who are closer to me than my breath
I won't say anything in front of you except for humble words.
